hook: Your drive in Norway goes underground for twenty minutes.
title: A Road Tunnel You Drive 20 Minutes Through
description:
The Lærdal Tunnel in Norway is 24.5 km long, the longest road tunnel in the world. Driving through takes around 20 minutes. Blue-lit caverns along the way break up the long drive. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Norway #LaerdalTunnel
